profile.tagline: Data Engineer for Spark, Databricks, dbt, Airflow and Azure

summary.summary: Twelve years in data, seven of them as a data engineer. Builds lakehouse platforms on Azure and Databricks, models data for analytics and keeps pipelines tested and observable.

list.details:
- Built a lakehouse for a trading company on Azure Data Lake Storage and Databricks, medallion layers bronze, silver and gold
- PySpark jobs for 60 sources (ERP, web shop, CSV deliveries), 1.5 TB per day
- 400 dbt models with tests and generated documentation, dimensional models in the gold layer
- Airflow on Kubernetes for orchestration, alerting on failed loads
- Access control with Unity Catalog, cost monitoring with budgets per workspace
- Feature tables for the data science team

- Moved smart meter processing (2 TB per day) from Azure Data Factory to Spark on Databricks with Delta Lake
- Introduced dbt for the reporting layer
- Feature pipelines with the Databricks Feature Store for a forecasting model
- Azure DevOps pipelines for deployment of notebooks and jobs

- Data warehouse on SQL Server with SSIS loads
- Star schemas for claims and contracts, reports in Power BI
- Performance tuning of SQL queries and indexes

- Data preparation and analysis in SQL and Python (pandas)
- Survey evaluation and reporting for clients

list.title: Reusable dbt tests and macros
list.tagline: A package of generic dbt tests (freshness, row count drift, referential checks) used across all projects of the team.

list.title: Smart meter lakehouse
list.tagline: Delta Lake design for 15-minute meter readings with late-arriving data and reprocessing.

list.title: Cost view for the data platform
list.tagline: A dashboard of Databricks and storage cost per team and job, with alerts when a budget is exceeded.
